item.title: Corps news: Fusion Core's 2027 repertoire, Boston Crusaders head to Canada, and more
item.description:
This week's corps news roundup from DCI covers several 2027 season storylines. Fusion Core has revealed its 2027 repertoire, the Boston Crusaders are set to perform in Canada in 2027, and the Raiders lent a helping hand to a Hawaiian marching band headed to the Macy's Parade. The edition also includes DCI All-Age updates.

With the 2027 season still months out, repertoire reveals and international performance plans are the early signals of what the summer will look like. Check the full roundup on dci.org for the details on each corps' announcement.

item.title: DCI maps out its 55th anniversary 2027 tour to Indianapolis
item.description:
The road to Indianapolis has officially been mapped out. Drum Corps International has released the highlights of its 2027 tour schedule, running from late June through mid-August, as the organization heads into its 55th anniversary season.

The full schedule will take corps across the country over the summer, culminating in the championship weekend in Indianapolis. For fans, the release is the starting gun for planning — which shows to attend, which corps to follow, and how the summer builds toward finals. More details on individual dates and stops are in the full announcement.
